# The same shape with no `$residual$` line — which is what a reader writes
# for a settlement that realizes nothing, and the form that used to slip
# through: the refusal only spoke when the block carried split lines.
#
# The invoice is already in the base currency, so it realizes nothing: a
# receivable holding CAD does not appreciate against CAD. What the HKD cost is
# a question about the bank account, answered where currency is bought.
#
# Left to run, this reached the basis drawdown and failed with "state
# `cost_basis_balance:` on that split" — which cannot be done, because the
# importer refuses that key on a CAD split and the split is written by the
# posting rather than by any directive.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:HKD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-CAD-INTO-HKD-BARE"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-CAD-INTO-HKD-BARE"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank:HKD"
		settled_amount: 780.00
		memo: "Payment for INV-CAD-INTO-HKD-BARE"
